snippet.title: Kryva Hora - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Watch this tense announcement trailer for Kryva Hora, an upcoming found-footage style survival horror game with microphone-supported gameplay. You've just found a tape taken in 1987 after the tragic explosion in Chornobyl. You have to survive and escape from the mutants and the hostile environment to finish your mission and close a portal to an alien world. The Kryva Hora trailer showcases how you can play as a person carrying out their mission or play as a monster to hunt your friends. Kryva Hora will be available on Steam in 2025.
